snippet.title: Luffi: Homebound Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Luffi: Homebound is our upcoming cozy game — a relaxing collectathon adventure where you guide a cute Red Panda on his journey home from art school to spend the summer holidays with his parents.

Wishlist us on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2433160/Luffi_Homebound/
